rationale: Bill is building LLM efficiency and real-time perception into General Instinct, while Romy has deep ML infrastructure experience from Google and is now focused on making AI systems practical for developers at Repeat AI. They can exchange perspectives on parameter-efficient fine-tuning, hardware optimizations, and developer-friendly tooling — areas where Romy's infrastructure background could inform Bill's applied ML research, and Bill's conviction around PEFT and sparse attention could shape how Repeat AI approaches accessibility.
intro_message: Bill Jiao, meet Romy Agrawal — you're both building at the intersection of ML infrastructure and practical AI products, and could explore how LLM efficiency and developer-friendly tooling overlap.
